title: GPT-Live shows how voice AI can listen and speak at the same time
friendlyTitle: Voice AI is learning to talk without awkward pauses
summary: OpenAI detailed the architecture behind GPT-Live, a full-duplex voice model that removes the separate turn detector and can listen while speaking. A dedicated media path keeps audio responsive while deeper reasoning and tool calls run asynchronously.
friendlySummary: GPT-Live can listen and speak at the same time. Slow tools run separately so they do not interrupt the conversation.
whyItMatters: Continuous voice makes assistants feel less like walkie-talkies and more useful for hands-busy work, accessibility, and agent coordination. The engineering pattern also gives developers a practical lesson: keep latency-sensitive interaction separate from slower tools and business logic.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make voice assistants easier to use while cooking, driving, working, or using accessibility tools.
